timeline.title: Seven steps to your keys.
timeline.lead: Each step is guided by a person from our team. Nothing is automated where it shouldn't be.
timeline.s1_b: You answer 8 short questions: city, type, bedrooms, price range, deadline, must-have features and payment method.
timeline.s2_b: Within 24h, a broker from your region reaches out to refine what you want. This is the moment to adjust.
timeline.s3_b: This is the differential. Targeted paid media + human curation identify motivated owners — including those who hadn't even thought about selling. Targeted campaigns awaken those who own the right property.
timeline.s4_b: You get 3 to 5 options with photos, tour video, and our honest assessment of strengths and weaknesses — often off-market properties.
timeline.s5_b: We schedule visits at your convenience. We go together — and ask the right questions to the seller.
timeline.s6_b: We handle the offer, counter-offer and closing. Your bargain is our bargain.
timeline.s7_b: We handle the deed, certifications, contract and financing (if applicable). You just sign.
